snippet.description:
If you are in college and unsure how to begin UPSC preparation, start by reading the syllabus, exploring optional subjects, taking your graduation subject seriously and developing a newspaper-reading habit. Sonia Ma'am breaks down the first practical steps.

Haven’t started your UPSC preparation yet?
Join our free 10-day bootcamp for UPSC beginners.
https://www.levelupias.com/upsc-aarambh/

Enrollment Open in GS Foundation Program for UPSC CSE 2028: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-gs-foundation-course/
